arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Boynton stated the fee places significant burdens on interstate commerce.
Mr. Digges described the fee as a $100 annual charge for point-to-point trucks.
Mr. Stewart argued the central question is not about apportioning the fee.
Mr. Hanson noted the companion case involves federal preemption of interstate fees.

paragraphs: Michigan charges a flat annual fee for trucks. Truckers say this fee burdens interstate commerce. The state defends the fee as a valid regulation.
